jobs.title: Senior Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a growing investment advisory and asset management firm transitioning into an AI-enabled, model-driven investment platform.

About the Role

This role is a hands-on leadership position focused on portfolio construction, execution oversight, and disciplined investment management. It is not a sales or asset-raising role.

Portfolio & Investment Management

Lead portfolio construction and ongoing portfolio maintenance across client mandates.
Implement the company's investment frameworks and model portfolios with discipline and consistency.
Monitor portfolio performance, risk metrics, and deviations from strategy.
Execute rebalancing decisions and oversee trade implementation in coordination with operations.
Identify portfolio risks, concentration issues, and execution inefficiencies.

Investment Oversight & Governance

Prepare periodic portfolio performance and risk reports for management and clients.
Ensure investment activities comply with CMA regulations and internal investment policies.
Support the Investment Committee with analysis, data, and execution feedback.
Maintain clear documentation of investment decisions and rationale.

Team & Platform Development

Act as the day-to-day investment lead as the asset management function scales.
Contribute to improving investment processes, tools, and reporting workflows.
Work closely with advisory and technology teams to support the company's AI-enabled investment model.
Support training and development of junior investment or portfolio support staff as the team grows.

Required Experience & Skills

6–10 years of experience in portfolio management or asset management.
Strong understanding of multi-asset portfolios (equities, fixed income, funds).
Solid grasp of portfolio risk management and analytics.
Hands-on, execution-oriented mindset.
Comfortable operating in a growing, evolving firm.
Strong Excel and portfolio analysis skills.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field.
CFA (or progress toward CFA) preferred.
Knowledge of CMA regulations required.

jobs.title: Financial Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job purpose**


Supporting the corporate team in its day\-to\-day business by providing, developing and enhancing the quality of credit decision management across business development departments and data analysis across credit portfolios.


**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct data analysis regarding transactions on credit facility applications received by the Department. Substantiate recommendations for use by Bank stakeholders to make decisions on new loans/investments, renewal, amendment and structuring of existing loans/investments.
* In\-depth analysis of available data, in a manner that develops effective and efficient risk identification, assessment and measurement, on all credit decisions.
* Provide decision\-makers with accurate numbers, information, data and analysis to ensure sound credit decisions that achieve the Bank's objectives.
* Review/analyze credit information and any matters related to credit reports, so that they include studying the conditions of the economic sector / financial solvency and continuity / status of mortgages and guarantors etc.
* Prepare detailed credit reports on the position of borrowers, including their credit status, repayment capabilities, potential risk of default, and interest of establishing/maintaining relationships with them etc. Submit observations to the direct supervisor.
* Provide all data and reports to relationship managers and direct manager as soon as requested for the purposes of facilitating the decision\-making process and developing recommendations.
* Contribute to the analysis of estimated cashflows by preparing necessary reports and providing the direct manager with all necessary data and information.
* Inform the direct supervisor of all developments, events and economic reports on the status of market sectors, credit portfolios, clients.
* Provide the necessary support for all projects related to companies’ business, in addition to providing those concerned with any data / reports / information needed.

  

**Requirements** **Skills and competencies:**

* University degree in Business Administration / Economics / Banking and Finance / Statistics or any related discipline.
* Work experience of at least (1\) year in the field of credit/data analysis in banks or related institutions.
* Possess analytical abilities that can use the best statistical and mathematical tools in addition to good abilities in quantitative calculations and knowledge of (stress tests, Basel, credit / market / operational / liquidity risk)
* Full knowledge of English.
* Competent use of computers and handling various application systems.
* Good knowledge of services and products provided by the Bank.
* Full knowledge of the policies and procedures that govern work and their internal and external updates.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Ability to communicate and interact well with others.
* Ability to plan and organize.
* Analytical capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a team.

jobs.description:

:
Join Standard Chartered as an Operational Risk Analyst, where your expertise will play a critical role in identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational and technology\-related risks within our dynamic banking environment. Based in Dubai, this full\-time office position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the robustness and resilience of our risk management framework, ensuring that our operations comply with regulatory requirements while delivering value to clients and stakeholders alike. You will engage with diverse teams across the organisation and help foster a proactive risk culture that supports sustainable business growth and operational excellence.


The role is well\-suited for individuals who thrive in a collaborative setting and are passionate about continuous improvement and innovation in risk practices. By supporting risk assessment initiatives and driving control enhancements, you will help reduce the potential operational impacts and strengthen the confidence our clients have in our services. This position embodies our commitment to active risk management as a cornerstone of our operational strategy.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Support the enterprise\-wide identification, assessment, and monitoring of operational and technology risks through detailed analysis and reporting.
* Prepare comprehensive risk reports, dashboards, and governance materials to inform business decisions and facilitate transparent communication with senior management.
* Track key risk indicators (KRIs), emerging risk trends, incidents, and evaluate the effectiveness of existing controls to ensure timely risk mitigation.
* Collaborate proactively with business units and functional teams to enhance risk awareness, strengthen control environments, and embed risk considerations into operational processes.
* Assist in conducting thorough risk and control assessments, following up on remediation plans and ensuring corrective actions are implemented efficiently.
* Participate actively in incident management processes, including root cause analysis, assessment of operational impact, and incorporation of lessons learned into risk frameworks.
* Support regulatory compliance efforts by contributing to audit preparations, governance reporting, and adherence to operational risk standards.
* Engage in continuous improvements of the operational risk framework, policies, and control standards to adapt to evolving business and regulatory landscapes.
* Contribute to risk reviews and assurance activities, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and identifying opportunities for process enhancement.
* Leverage risk analytics and scenario analysis techniques to detect emerging threats and advise on strategic risk responses.
* Support cross\-functional projects aimed at enhancing operational resilience and governance practices throughout the organisation.
* Foster a culture of strong risk governance by engaging with stakeholders to promote effective communication, training, and adherence to risk policies.
**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* Strong analytical mindset and problem\-solving capabilities, with an aptitude for synthesising complex information to inform decision\-making.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, enabling clear articulation of risk findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships, build trust, and work collaboratively across functions in a multicultural environment.
* Meticulous attention to detail and excellent organisational skills to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, particularly advanced Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for reporting and presentations.
* Capability to adapt to evolving priorities, showing resilience and flexibility in a fast\-paced working environment.
* Experience or familiarity with operational risk management frameworks, risk assessment tools, or regulatory requirements is advantageous.
* A commitment to continuous learning and professional development in risk management and related fields.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Risk Management, or a closely related discipline from a recognised institution.
* Fluent proficiency in English, with strong communication skills suitable for an international banking environment.
* Professional certifications in risk management such as FRM (Financial Risk Manager) or CRM (Certified Risk Manager) would be considered an asset but are not mandatory.
* Experience or knowledge of regulatory environments relevant to the UAE or international banking is beneficial.
* A keen understanding of operational risk principles, governance frameworks, and compliance standards.
**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. jobs.title: Senior Portfolio Manager, Workflow Engine (Remote)
jobs.description:
While this role is remote, there is a preference to candidates that reside near our Fort Wayne (IN), Portage (MI), or San Jose (CA) offices.

This role serves as the business and product leader for Workflow Engine and related integration technologies, partnering closely with customers, engineering, architecture, UX, sales, and operations teams to bring innovative solutions to market. The Portfolio Manager will identify unmet customer needs, evaluate market opportunities, and develop strategies that enable healthcare organizations to seamlessly connect systems, automate workflows, and unlock greater value from the SmartCare platform.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

Define and communicate the strategic vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for Workflow Engine and SmartCare integration capabilities.
Develop multi-year product strategies aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, business objectives, and platform architecture.
Balance customer value, technical feasibility, scalability, security, interoperability, and commercial objectives when prioritizing product investments.
Ensure alignment across engineering, architecture, portfolio management, commercial teams, and executive stakeholders around common goals and priorities.
Lead portfolio planning activities, including business case development, investment recommendations, roadmap prioritization, and lifecycle management.
Partner closely with Solution Architecture and Engineering teams to translate strategy into execution.

Innovation & Market Opportunity Development

Identify emerging technologies, industry trends, and innovation opportunities related to middleware, APIs, workflow automation, interoperability, orchestration, cloud platforms, and digital health ecosystems.
Evaluate market opportunities and recommend strategic investments that strengthen SmartCare's competitive position.
Challenge conventional thinking and champion innovative solutions that solve complex healthcare workflow challenges.
Anticipate future market needs and proactively develop strategies to address evolving healthcare technology landscapes.
Drive "art of the possible" thinking to identify new ways workflow automation and integrations can deliver customer and business value.

Customer & Market Insights

Develop deep expertise in healthcare workflows, integration challenges, interoperability requirements, and customer operational needs.
Engage directly with customers, health systems, implementation teams, and key opinion leaders to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.
Translate customer feedback into actionable product requirements and strategic recommendations.
Establish and maintain relationships with key customers, partners, and industry experts to inform future roadmap decisions.
Become a trusted source of market and customer insights for the broader SmartCare organization.

Product Development & Cross-Functional Leadership

Lead product discovery efforts and define market requirements for new capabilities and enhancements.
Partner with Engineering, UX, Clinical Portfolio Management, Program Management, and Operations teams throughout the product lifecycle.
Define product requirements, success metrics, and value propositions for new initiatives.
Lead the product planning process from ideation through launch and post-market optimization.
Influence product development decisions through data, customer insights, market intelligence, and business analysis.
Ensure product strategies consider scalability, deployment, supportability, observability, security, and integration requirements.

Ecosystem, Integrations & Platform Expansion

Define the strategy for internal and external integrations across the SmartCare ecosystem.
Evaluate partnership opportunities that expand platform capabilities and customer value.
Promote reusable, scalable integration frameworks and approaches that accelerate adoption and reduce implementation complexity.
Collaborate with platform, middleware, device, and application teams to deliver cohesive, end-to-end customer solutions.
Develop strategies that enable seamless interoperability across healthcare applications, devices, and technology ecosystems.

Competitive & Industry Intelligence

Monitor competitive offerings, technology trends, emerging standards, and market disruptions.
Analyze competitive strengths, weaknesses, market positioning, and innovation investments.
Assess industry developments related to interoperability, workflow automation, AI-enabled workflows, cloud infrastructure, and digital health platforms.
Translate competitive intelligence into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy and roadmap priorities.
Educate stakeholders on market dynamics, industry trends, and competitive threats.

Business Performance & Analytics

Develop and maintain business cases, financial models, product forecasts, and investment recommendations.
Define key performance indicators and success metrics for the portfolio.
Monitor product adoption, utilization, customer satisfaction, commercial performance, and market outcomes.
Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify growth opportunities and support strategic decision-making.
Communicate portfolio performance and strategic recommendations to leadership.
Demonstrate strong financial and business acumen when evaluating opportunities and prioritizing investments.

Leadership & Influence

Build strong partnerships across business functions and organizational boundaries.
Influence decisions and drive alignment without direct authority.
Mentor team members and contribute to the development of product management best practices.
Communicate effectively with technical, clinical, commercial, and executive audiences.
Foster a culture of innovation, customer-centricity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Serve as a recognized subject matter expert in workflow automation, integrations, and platform strategy.

What you need (required):

Bachelor's degree required;
6+ years of professional experience
Experience in Product Management/Portfolio Management for Enterprise Software, Healthcare Technology, Digital Health, Platform Products, Middleware, or related fields.
Experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for software, platform, middleware, API, integration, or workflow automation products.
Strong understanding of software development processes, cloud architectures, APIs, integration technologies, and interoperability concepts.
Demonstrated ability to identify market opportunities and convert customer needs into successful product strategies.
Healthcare IT, interoperability, FHIR, HL7, clinical workflow, or digital health experience preferred.
Experience with middleware, workflow orchestration, enterprise integration platforms, or connected ecosystem products strongly preferred.

Preferred:

MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Posted Date: 09/03/2026 This role will be posted for a minimum of 3 days.

jobs.title: Commercial Lending Portfolio Manager - Fresno, CA
jobs.description:
Associates at California Bank & Trust work in a relationship-centered culture where they are provided with the tools, training, and opportunities to build the best possible relationships with our clients and with each other. Our workplace culture values each associate’s unique experiences, background and perspectives and provides a collaborative environment for all employees to grow and thrive.    

As a premier California-focused financial services company dedicated to serving its communities, families, and businesses (small, mid-sized and large), CB&T has been active for 70 years and has more than 80 full-service branch offices across the state. This dedication has helped the bank earn recognition as a perennial powerhouse in yearly voting for “Best Bank” and “Best Commercial Bank” from the readers of San Diego Union-Tribune and Orange County Register. Additionally, as a division of Zions Bancorporation, the bank has collected multiple Greenwich Excellence Awards for “Overall Client Satisfaction” in Small Business & Middle Market Excellence Awards. 

We are looking for a seasoned Portfolio Manager in Fresno, CA to join our Commercial Banking team. This critical role focuses on underwriting new credit requests and servicing a portfolio of existing Commercial Real Estate (CRE) and Commercial & Industrial (C&I) loan relationships. Successful candidates will have the ability to execute complex credit analysis, financial spreading, underwriting, risk monitoring, and structure/pricing optimization as a member of a collaborative team.

Essential Functions:

Responsible for providing analysis and underwriting for new C&I and CRE credit requests.
Responsible for managing and servicing a portfolio of existing loan relationships.
Responsible for expanding and building relationships with a high degree of resultant customer satisfaction as an extension of the relationship management team.
Responsible for ensuring financial statements are spread and analyzed, addressing industry risks, monitoring collateral requirements, loan structuring and pricing, credit analysis, monitoring credit performance and assisting with loan presentations.
Handles reporting on loans such as past dues, documentation and collateral exceptions, financial performance updates, portfolio profitability, risk grades, etc.
Keeps informed of financial and market trends in the portfolio and analyzes those trends for the effect they will have on the portfolio.
Assists bankers with new and existing loan requests and other special projects.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Requires a bachelor's degree in Finance, Business or other related field and 4+ years of banking, relationship management, underwriting and credit experience or other directly related experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may meet qualifications.
Working knowledge of various types of loans, credit analysis, spreading and analyzing financial statements, risk analysis, credit scoring, loan documentation, etc.
Knowledge of banking products, services, policies, procedures and regulations.
Strong credit skills in underwriting, financial modeling, valuations and adherence to policy.
Requires strong customer service, relationship, organizational, analytical and creative problem solving skills.
Ability to meet deadlines.
Must have strong communications skills, both verbal and written.
Knowledge of various software applications including word processing and spreadsheets.

Benefits:

Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance - START DAY ONE!

Health Savings (HSA), Flexible Spending (FSA) and dependent care accounts
Paid Training, Paid Time Off (PTO) and 11 Paid Federal Holidays, and any applicable state holidays

Mental health benefits including coaching and therapy sessions
Tuition Reimbursement for qualifying employees enrolled in an accredited degree program related to the needs of the business, maximum of $5,250 per calendar year, employees are eligible for the program upon hire
Employee Ambassador preferred banking products

Serve as a reliable point of contact for clients and internal teams, bringing subject matter expertise in quantitative investing to every interaction
Partner across teams to share insights, tackle problems together, and drive meaningful improvements to both client experience and operational efficiency
Show up for your teammates and contribute to a culture where everyone is empowered to do their best work

1\. Support the development and maintenance of pricing and residual value policies, methodologies, and governance frameworks.

**Business Transformation \& Data Analytics**

  



1\. Develop automated pricing and profitability dashboards using advanced analytics tools.

jobs.title: Senior Cards Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

We're looking for an experienced Portfolio Growth Manager to own the growth and health of Tabby's card program end\-to\-end.  


  

This role sits at the intersection of scheme relationships, compliance and commercial strategy working closely with Card Scheme, Compliance, Risk and Product to grow card issuance, activation and usage while keeping the program fully aligned with scheme rules and regulatory requirements.  


  

You'll lead portfolio growth initiatives, manage scheme relationships and reporting, and own the compliance obligations tied to the card program — from scheme mandates to regulatory requirements. You're comfortable balancing a commercial growth agenda with the discipline compliance demands.  


  

If you enjoy growing a card program commercially while also being the person who keeps it compliant and audit\-ready, this role is for you.  

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own portfolio growth strategy for Tabby's card program including driving growth across the funnel and identify and execute growth levers pricing, incentives and partnerships.
* Manage day\-to\-day relationships with card schemes, including program reporting, mandates, incentives and new scheme initiatives.
* Ensure the card program's ongoing compliance with scheme rules, regulatory requirements and internal risk policies.
* Partner with Compliance, Risk and Legal to manage scheme audits, certifications and regulatory filings related to the card program.
* Track and report portfolio performance (activation, spend, retention) and compliance status to internal and external stakeholders.
* Stay ahead of scheme rule changes and regulatory updates, translating them into action plans across the business.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to prioritize features that support both growth and compliance goals.

  


### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* 3–4 years of experience in banking or fintech, with direct exposure to card programs, scheme management or compliance.
* Working knowledge of card scheme rule and the regulatory requirements governing card programs.
* Strong analytical skills, comfortable working with portfolio performance data to drive growth decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills to work across Compliance, Risk, Marketing, Product \& Tech and external scheme partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English \& Arabic a must

  


### **Benefits**

  

* We have an inclusive company culture, embracing diversity, integrity and transparency. We strive for work\-life balance and cherish the moments you spend with your loved ones, off\-work. In the same spirit as for our product, we are caring and nurturing for our employees.
* Our people are granted 100% trust and freedom to apply their own vision and come up with their ideas from day 1 at Tabby. You are the one who takes responsibility for your area of work. We encourage everyone to think and make decisions like Tabby was their own business, well because it is. Our employee stock options programme is available for everyone.
* You will have an opportunity to learn and grow in one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the region
* We offer you relocation support as well as we guide you through all the process.
* We’ll set you up with the devices required for your work.

### **About Tabby**


Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save, by reshaping their relationship with money.  

  

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in\-store with no interest or fees. Over 32,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA and Shein use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.  

  

Tabby has generated over $7 billion in transaction volume for its partner brands and has the highest rated, most reviewed, largest and fastest growing app of any fintech in the GCC region.  

  

Tabby launched operations in 2020 and has raised \+$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors.

About Us

At We.
, we've spent decades at the intersection of technology and humanity, bridging the gap between what businesses create and how people experience those creations. That need could be for trust, connection, safety, or a sense of purpose. But it’s always there. And it is only by uncovering these truths that we can make real, meaningful progress.

About The Role

The Sr. Financial Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis will be responsible for complex financial processes which affect numerous positions and roles and will have material financial impact throughout the Company. Significant amounts of time spent will be in the organization and coordination of the budget, forecast and reporting. This position requires a strong analytical, organized business thinker who can resolve complex problems with minimal supervision. Creativity and desire to understand the PR marketplace is important in order to understand the business impacts to the company. This role will/may consult with all levels of management throughout every division and unit in the company, globally. All information received and produced is of a sensitive and confidential nature, so integrity is required.

Responsibilities

Review monthly financial summaries (standard reports, variance analysis, performance recaps) and discuss financial highlights with business partners

Lead and prepare analyses that aid in decision making and improving profitability and margins for the company.
Utilize raw data to perform quantitative analysis in evaluating metric performance, operations results, resource usage and variances

External Job Description

Position Summary

The FP&A Analyst supports the North America FP&A team by delivering accurate, timely financial analysis and recurring reporting that enables effective planning, forecasting, and performance management.This role works closely with senior FP&A team members, plant controllers, and cross-functional partners to execute standard FP&A processes, consolidate plant and functional inputs, and ensure data integrity across operational and commercial reporting.

Key Responsibilities

FP&A Core Responsibilities

Support monthly forecasting, quarterly outlook, and annual budgeting cycles using established models, templates, and standard work.
Prepare standard management reports, variance analyses, and performance summaries for review by senior FP&A team members.
Consolidate and validate financial data from plant controllers and functional partners, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Assist with preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for North America leadership.

Business Partnering (Ops & Commercial)

Respond to defined analytical requests from Operations and Sales partners.
Support analysis of volume, cost, productivity, and margin drivers using established frameworks.
Develop foundational understanding of manufacturing and commercial performance drivers.

Process, Systems & Standard Work

Follow FP&A standard work, SOPs, and reporting calendars.
Maintain templates, trackers, and recurring reports.
Use FP&A systems and tools (ERP, planning systems, BI tools) as designed.
Identify data or process issues and escalate appropriately.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or related field.
2–4 years of experience in FP&A, finance, or analytical roles.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong Excel skills; exposure to Power BI or similar tools preferred.
Manufacturing or operational finance exposure preferred.

Behavioral Competencies

Detail-oriented with strong execution discipline.
Developing professional judgment.
Strong learning mindset and coachability.
Collaborative and dependable team contributor.

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Senior Financial Analyst will play a critical role in supporting Diligent’ s financial planning and analysis efforts across assigned regions or business areas. This role provides deep insights and actionable recommendations that inform both strategic and operational decisions. The Senior Financial Analyst leads budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling activities, while partnering closely with cross-functional teams and business leaders to drive performance and operational efficiency. The successful candidate demonstrates advanced analytical skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence stakeholders through clear, data-driven insights.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design, maintenance, and enhancement of financial reporting packages, models, and dashboards to support business decision-making
Analyze, consolidate, and interpret complex financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and actionable business insights
Drive budgeting, forecasting, and monthly/quarterly management reporting processes, ensuring alignment with company goals and financial statements
Prepare and present financial materials for leadership and Board meetings, providing analysis and recommendations
Partner with cross-functional teams (Accounting, Sales Operations, HR, Product, etc.) to support financial planning, process improvements, and strategic initiatives
Perform advanced ad-hoc financial analyses to guide key operational and strategic decisions
Identify opportunities to improve financial systems, tools, and processes for enhanced efficiency and data accuracy
Mentor and provide guidance to junior analysts as needed, contributing to team development and knowledge sharing

Required Experience/Skills

2-5 years of experience in financial reporting, analysis, or FP&A
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; advanced degrees or certifications (CPA, CFA) a plus
Strong financial analysis, modelling, and forecasting skills, with the ability to handle complex datasets and provide actionable insights
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables, charts, macros, etc.) and familiarity with financial systems or BI tools
Proven ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and influence decision-making across multiple teams
Strategic mindset, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with stakeholders
High level of integrity and confidentiality when handling sensitive financial information

$90,000—$124,000 USD

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. jobs.description:
Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com , Target.com , eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email [email protected] .

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We’re looking for a high-impact Sr. Financial Analyst to revolutionize how we analyze and optimize our technology infrastructure, with a direct focus on the high-growth frontier of AI, storage, and compute costs. In this role, you won’t just run reports—you’ll take command of critical workstreams, forge powerful partnerships between our engineering and finance teams, and play a pivotal role in shaping Pattern’s investment strategies. This is a full-time, hybrid opportunity based at our headquarters in Lehi, UT.

What is a day in the life of a Sr. Financial Analyst?

Support planning, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and variance analysis for AI usage, compute, storage, and software costs
Perform investment analysis and evaluate commercial decisions and strategic initiatives
Prepare high-quality analyses, recommendations, and Exec and Board-facing presentations
Support business partners across compute infrastructure, FP&A, and strategic finance.

What will I need to thrive in this role?

3-5 years in a finance operating role at a high-growth technology company
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or other relevant fields
Background in infrastructure, data centers, compute, cloud, semiconductors, or a related industry strongly preferred
Exceptional analytical, financial modeling, and written and verbal communication skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and succeed in unfamiliar operating environments
Comfort independently structuring ambiguous problems and working through incomplete information
Track record of producing high-quality work under ambitious deadlines
Effectiveness in multidisciplinary, cross-functional environments
Familiarity with data systems, analytical tools, and large datasets preferred but not required

What does high performance look like?

Proactively identifies cost-saving or efficiency opportunities within complex compute, storage, and AI infrastructure datasets.
Translates technical infrastructure metrics into clear, actionable financial models that influence leadership decision-making.
Builds strong, trusting partnerships across finance and engineering teams, effectively communicating financial constraints and opportunities.
Consistently delivers high-quality, 'audit-ready' analyses and Board-level presentations under tight deadlines.
Demonstrates a 'Game Changer' mindset by continuously improving reporting processes and tackling ambiguous data problems independently.
You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is my potential for career growth?

At Pattern, career paths are defined by your momentum. Your growth is a direct reflection of your initiative, work ethic, and drive to deliver results. While we provide the high-growth platform, your trajectory is ultimately defined by you. Bring your best, and you’ll have the opportunity to take full ownership of your role, influence our strategic direction, and help shape the future.

What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

30 Days: Learning & Discovery

Conduct a deep dive into existing compute and AI infrastructure cost drivers, data sources, and current forecasting methodologies.
Establish baseline relationships with key business partners across engineering and compute operations to understand current pain points and reporting needs.

60 Days: Analysis & Initial Ownership

Take full ownership of the monthly reporting cycle for compute costs, proactively identifying variances and streamlining data collection.
Execute a focused analysis of a specific AI/storage cost stream to identify potential efficiency or optimization opportunities.

90 Days: Strategy & Execution

Propose and initiate a strategic optimization project based on findings from initial analysis, presenting a data-backed recommendation to stakeholders.
Begin leading ad-hoc investment analyses for strategic initiatives, demonstrating the ability to structure ambiguous problems and communicate results to leadership.

What is the team like?

You will work with the other Financial Analysts and be supervised by the FP&A Manager. You will also be mentored by the Head of FP&A and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

Sounds great! What’s the company culture?

We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are

Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team
Video interview with a hiring manager
Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
Professional reference checks
Executive review
Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

Discuss professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
Provide insights on how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
Focus on mentioning how you would be partner obsessed at Pattern
Share experience on any side projects related to data and analytics

Why should I work at Pattern?

Benefits

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

Unlimited PTO
Paid Holidays
Onsite Fitness Center
Company Paid Life Insurance
Casual Dress Code
Competitive Pay
Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.

in our Cleveland
office! This position is hybrid and has work from home flexibility.

Position Summary

Do you enjoyed preparing budgets, forecasting, financial reporting? Is figuring out the puzzle by performing analysis something you see as a challenge? Do you see ad-hoc reporting as an exciting twist to your day? Then the Sr. Financial Analyst
position may be what you're looking for! This position is for the senior-level, experienced financial professional who loves all things Excel and brings their forte of modeling and benchmarking to the table!

The Senior Financial Analyst is responsible for preparing and analyzing financial reports, monitoring key performance metrics, and supporting budgeting and forecasting. The position collaborates with firm leaders to deliver insights, perform detailed analyses, and assist with benchmarking and predictive modeling to guide decision-making and improve overall performance.

Essential Functions

Develops, maintains, and assists in preparing weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for firm management, including analyzing financial statements, key performance indicators, budget performance, and reconciliations.
Manages project deadlines by planning work, prioritizing tasks, tracking progress, identifying risks early, and coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of accurate analysis/information.
Performs complex and detailed analyses to review firm performance across key metrics and identifies areas for improvement.
Processes, cleans, and validates data to support predictive analysis and data modeling for future planning and forecasting.
Identifies and assesses current performance across all practice groups and departments, comparing results to historical trends.
Collaborates with FP&A team and other departments throughout firm to create/design new reports/tools to analyze firm performance and meet evolving needs.
Serves as a vital resource for practice group leaders, department heads, and senior staff, addressing a variety of financial and analytical needs.
Assists with the firm's budgeting and forecasting process, ensuring proposals are complete, accurate, and compliant with budgeting guidelines.
Reviews general ledger expense details and compares with budgets and forecasts to assess successes and identify potential areas for improvement at the firm, department, and team levels.
Creates and analyzes detailed and thorough budget reports to determine performance versus the firm's budget and forecast.
Prepares and assists in the preparation of external benchmarking surveys to evaluate the firm's performance in comparison with industry peers.

Qualifications

The Senior Financial Analyst must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration, along with 8+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, financial reporting or accounting. A demonstrated advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including expertise with pivot tables, lookups, advanced formulas, macros, Power Query and data manipulation is required. Experience and in-depth knowledge of financial analysis, modeling, budgeting, and financial statement preparation is required. Law Firm experience preferred. Exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical and critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities is required. Effective written and verbal communication skills is essential, including the ability to prepare and summarize complex financial data in an accurate, concise and effective manner. The Senior Financial Analyst must be a quick learner who can effectively manage and prioritize parallel tasks and perform under tight deadlines, demonstrate excellent organizational skills, and work well both independently and as part of a team. Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with the appropriate discretion. A commitment to providing outstanding customer service is essential.

jobs.title: Senior Portfolio Manager - Alternative Assets
jobs.description:
**About ENBD**

Emirates NBD is a market leader across the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving over 9 million customers. Emirates NBD is the leading financial services brand in the UAE with a Brand value of approximately USD 4 billion. We serve our customers and help them realise their financial objectives through a range of banking products and services including retail banking, corporate \& institutional banking, Islamic banking, investment banking, private banking, asset management, global markets and treasury, and brokerage operations. We are a key participant in the global digital banking industry, with 97% of all financial transactions and requests conducted outside of our branches. We also operate Liv, the lifestyle digital bank by Emirates NBD. With over half a million users, it continues to be the fastest\-growing digital bank in the region.


**Job Overview:**

As a Senior Portfolio Manager \- Alternative Assets at Emirates NBD, your role is to support the identification, assessment, underwriting and execution of real estate acquisitions and disposals across the funds and mandates managed by the Real Estate team within Alternative Assets, including ENBD REIT and the private real estate funds platform. The job holder leads the analytical workstream on transactions — market research, financial modelling and returns analysis, due diligence coordination, and preparation of Investment Committee and Board submissions — and runs the internal approval process, coordinating deal structuring with the product / fund structuring team and securing sign\-off from group governance, risk, compliance and Shari'a. The role works under the supervision of the Head of Real Estate but is expected to self\-manage workload across a live pipeline. As a DFSA\-regulated manager, all work must comply with the DFSA Collective Investment Rules and international best practice for real estate funds. Following completion, the job holder supports clean handover of assets to the asset management function. Real estate investment is cyclical; during quieter transactional periods the role supports portfolio analysis, valuations and reporting.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain cash\-flow and returns models (levered / unlevered IRR, equity multiple, yield\-on\-cost, exit and sensitivity analysis)
* Research markets, comparables and pricing
* Prepare Investment Committee and Board submissions
* Appoint and manage valuers, lawyers, engineers and other specialists
* Track and resolve matters arising
* Synthesise findings into a clear recommendation
* Coordinate acquisition / disposal structuring with the product / fund structuring team (SPVs, fund perimeter, financing)
* Obtain sign\-off from risk, compliance and Shari'a
* Support Shari'a screening and structuring of transactions
* Maintain the deal pipeline tracker
* Monitor market activity, comparable transactions and opportunities
* Support transfer of leases, authorities and documentation
Contribute to the initial asset business plan  
* 

**Skills and Experience:**

* MBA, CA, or Engineering degree
* Approximately 15 years of experience in Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A), Investment Banking, Asset Management, or Private Equity
* Strong background in direct deal execution, private equity investments, and transaction management
* Expertise in financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, and investment analysis
* Experience in deal origination, structuring, and transaction documentation, including legal and commercial aspects
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with strong presentation and stakeholder management skills
Proven ability to prepare investment papers, business cases, and deal presentations  
* 

**There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.**We’re one of the region’s most recognisable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.


At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

The Financial Analyst will provide essential financial and analytical support to the team, ensuring accurate financial data, forecasts, and strategic insights to support decision\-making. The role involves analyzing property performance, conducting financial modeling, and reporting on financial results to guide the organization’s investment and business strategies.


Savills is a leading global real estate services company providing expertise across property advisory, investment management, valuation, property management, and consultancy. With a strong international presence, Savills works with investors, developers, landlords, and occupiers to deliver strategic real estate solutions across a wide range of markets and property sectors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain detailed financial models to assess property investments, acquisitions, and projects.

**2\. Budgeting \& Forecasting**

* Assist in preparing annual budgets and financial forecasts.
* Monitor actual performance against budgeted financial targets, identify variances, and provide actionable insights.

**3\. Reporting \& Presentations**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports on company and property performance.
* Present financial insights and reports to senior management and key stakeholders.

**4\. Cash Flow \& Asset Management**

* Analyze cash flows and ensure accurate tracking of income and expenses.
* Collaborate with managers to assess financial and asset performance and provide recommendations for cost optimization and revenue enhancement.

**5\. Collaboration**

* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to support financial analysis, reporting, and business objectives.

**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. A Master’s degree or CFA designation is a plus.
* **Experience:** 2–4 years of experience in real estate finance, investment banking, or financial analysis.
* **Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and advanced functions, as well as Power BI and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as D365 or Infor is preferred.
* Knowledge of real estate market trends, valuation techniques, and financial reporting.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present financial reports effectively.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Fluency in English is required.

**Key Attributes**

* Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a team.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy in financial analysis.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail\-oriented Prop Firm Risk Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for monitoring trader activity, identifying potential risks, analyzing trading performance, and ensuring compliance with the company's risk management policies and trading rules.

The Risk Analyst will play a key role in protecting the company's capital and maintaining a sustainable trading environment by monitoring trading behaviour, risk exposure, drawdowns, and potential violations of company rules.

Candidates with knowledge and experience in Forex trading, proprietary trading firms, financial markets, and risk management will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and analyze traders' activities and trading behaviour on a daily basis.
* Identify unusual, high\-risk, or potentially abusive trading patterns.
* Monitor risk exposure across different trading accounts and instruments.
* Review traders' drawdown levels, daily losses, maximum losses, and overall account performance.
* Ensure traders are complying with the company's trading rules and risk management policies.
* Identify potential violations of risk limits and escalate them to the relevant management team.
* Analyze trading strategies and patterns to identify excessive risk\-taking.
* Monitor position sizes, leverage usage, trading frequency, and overall market exposure.
* Review profitable and high\-performing trading accounts for potential risk concerns or rule violations.
* Investigate suspicious trading activity, including potential manipulation, arbitrage abuse, or prohibited trading practices, according to company policies.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly risk reports.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve the company's risk management framework.
* Work closely with the Operations, Compliance, Trading, and Management teams.
* Monitor market conditions and major economic events that may increase trading risk.
* Assist in developing and improving risk policies, trading rules, and internal procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of risk assessments, trader reviews, and incidents.
* Support the team in making data\-driven decisions regarding trader accounts and overall company risk exposure.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Previous experience in Forex, CFD, Proprietary Trading (Prop Firm), Brokerage, Financial Markets, or Trading Risk Management is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Forex and financial markets.
* Understanding of proprietary trading firm business models.

* Leverage

* Drawdown

* Position Sizing
* Daily Loss Limits

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to analyze trading data and identify patterns.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Experience with trading platforms and back\-office systems will be an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
* Good communication and reporting skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
* Experience working with a Forex broker or Prop Trading Firm.

* Knowledge of CRM, trading dashboards, and reporting systems is preferred.

jobs.description:
Job Req ID: 17415
Description:
**Aramco energizes the world economy.**


Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.


With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.


Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.


We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.


**Overview**
------------


We are seeking an Oil \& Gas Financial Analyst to join the Investment \& Portfolio Analysis Division in the Downstream Strategy and Capital Planning Department (DS\&CP).


DS\&CP is responsible for the coordination and development support of all of Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Investment Plan and Strategy. It also provides quantitative input to Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Executive Committees, working in close co\-operation with other Strategy \& Capital Planning Divisions across the organization.


As the Downstream Financial Analyst, your primary role is to provide quantitative financial analysis and confirmation of Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Investment Plan strategic fit.


**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------


As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:


* Developing complete Financial Statements Models.
* Analyze, evaluate and compare all the operational and financial inputs of the oil \& gas entities, assets and projects through the cycle
* Calculate and evaluate all economic parameters related with the profitability of Oil \& Gas projects.
* Valuation of Companies and Assets and applying different valuation methodologies and evaluating risks associated with the valuation via scenarios including stochastic analysis in addition to detailed competitive analysis.
* Applying Capital Budgeting and corporate finance concepts and tools for the investment plan analysis including Capital asset pricing model, returns per unit of risk, derivatives, fixed income, currency, hedging, corporate rating methodologies and others.
* Applies economic transaction fundamentals: “arms\-length” agreements, conflict of interests, public vs non\-public information, material vs non\-material information, corporate governance, market regulations and others.
**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------


As the successful candidate you will have:


* A Bachelor’s degree in in Economics and/or Engineering from a recognized and approved program. CFA, MBA or a relevant advanced financial degree is strongly preferred.
* A minimum of (15\) years of experience ideally in Oil \& Gas Financial Markets.
* Demonstrable experience of tracking record of modeling and valuations for the Downstream sector. Mainly focus in refining and petrochemicals but also other downstream segments (trading, retail, low carbon energies). Investment banking Sell side industry Is referred.
* Experience with asset financial modelling and financial research tools (e.g Bloomberg, Factset, Reuters, CapitalIQ…) as well as data management and use from main downstream / industry consulting entities (HIS, S\&P, WoodMackenzie, Rystad).
**Work Location and Work Schedule**
-----------------------------------


**Work Location:** Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer


**Work Schedule:** Full Time \- To be specified in Job offer


**Job Post Duration**
---------------------


Job posting start date: 02/10/2026


Job posting end date: 12/31/2026


**Working environment**

Our high\-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.


At Aramco, our people work on truly world\-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.


We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector\-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager - Alternative Assets
jobs.description:
**About ENBD**

Emirates NBD is a market leader across the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving over 9 million customers. Emirates NBD is the leading financial services brand in the UAE with a Brand value of approximately USD 4 billion. We serve our customers and help them realise their financial objectives through a range of banking products and services including retail banking, corporate \& institutional banking, Islamic banking, investment banking, private banking, asset management, global markets and treasury, and brokerage operations. We are a key participant in the global digital banking industry, with 97% of all financial transactions and requests conducted outside of our branches. We also operate Liv, the lifestyle digital bank by Emirates NBD. With over half a million users, it continues to be the fastest\-growing digital bank in the region.


**Job Overview:**

As a Senior Portfolio Manager \- Alternative Assets at Emirates NBD, your role is to assist the senior members of the team in the management of direct and indirect (fund\-of\-funds) investments focused on Private Credit . Tasks to include due diligence, deployment, monitoring, governance, risk oversight, and coordination across structuring, operations, and reporting functions.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct investment due diligence (DD) on private asset managers, direct deals across alternative assets focused on private credit.
* Assess track record, strategy alignment, legal and operational frameworks of fund managers.
* Conduct on\-site visits, reference checks, and prepare DD reports for internal stakeholders.
* Monitor performance of underlying fund managers and direct real estate investments.
* Analyze periodic reports, financial statements, and KPIs; flag deviations from expected performance.
* Maintain updated dashboards and performance summaries for internal use.
* Monitor and track capital deployment timelines in line with approved allocation plans.
* Coordinate with fund managers, legal counsel, and internal teams for smooth execution.
* Assist in preparation of key documents such as PPMs, subscription agreements, side letters, and SPAs.
* Support governance processes including quarterly portfolio reviews, internal controls, and compliance protocols.
* Ensure adherence to investment policies, limits, and framework across portfolio.
* Liaise with senior members of the team for communication with internal committees and auditors for transparency and control.
* Identify, track, and mitigate risks related to portfolio exposures, leverage, concentration, and liquidity.
* Work with risk teams to model stress scenarios and establish early warning indicators.
* Contribute towards development of a pipeline of direct deals and private fund opportunities across geographies and sectors.
* Develop internal thematic research to support investment decisions.
* Help Senior PM in preparation of high\-quality investment memos for Investment Committee and Board approval.
* Synthesize complex investment ideas into clear and concise documents with risk\-return analysis and recommendations.
* Conduct or support ODD reviews on private asset funds, including operational systems, governance, controls, valuation, and compliance processes.
* Collaborate with external consultants or internal risk/operations teams for thorough assessments.
* Contribute to the design of new fund products or investment vehicles aligned with market demand and internal strategy.
* Prepare business cases, support fund marketing, and liaise with external stakeholders (e.g. distributors, regulators).
* Support structuring of fund\-of\-funds vehicles, co\-investment programs, and direct deals.
* Help Senior PM in working with legal, tax, and structuring advisors to optimize fund terms and governance models.
* Draft or review term sheets, JV agreements, and shareholder agreements for direct investments.
* Act as liaison between investment and operations teams to ensure seamless execution and ongoing management.
* Support investor reporting, fund audits, regulatory filings, and accounting reviews.
* Ensure alignment on NAV reporting, capital account statements, waterfall calculations, and compliance requirements.

**Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* CFA/CA/MBA/CPA
* 5\-10 years of experience in private markets (direct or indirect deals / fund\-of\-funds / co\-investments / secondaries / transaction advisory / consulting).
* Prior work experience in Private Credit
* Strong exposure to due diligence, portfolio monitoring, and fund structuring.
* Strong analytical, financial modelling, and presentation skills.
* Understanding of fund documentation, legal structures, offshore tax structures and governance.

**There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.**We’re one of the region’s most recognisable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.


At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

Our Team

Innovation – We’re a technology-driven team with the purpose of uplifting the real estate sector. We are the leaders of the industry in innovation.

Empowerment & Collaboration – Our team is the most valuable aspect of the company; We respect all ideas, our team enjoys authority, autonomy, and collaboration.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst
to partner closely with our CFO and turn complex financial and portfolio data into clear operating and funding decisions. In this role, you will own the models, forecasts, and analysis used by our executive team, funding partners, board, and investors. This role suits someone who builds from first principles, thrives through imperfect data, and communicates commercial and liquidity insights with razor-sharp clarity.

What will you be doing?

Financial Modeling: Build, stress-test, and maintain driver-based 3-statement, funding, and scenario models. Connect contract economics, yield, funding cost, credit loss, and servicing cost-to cash flow, profitability, and balance-sheet outcomes.
Asset-Backed Financing: Own the analytical and reporting engine for asset-backed and warehouse facilities, including eligibility, borrowing-base availability, advance rates, utilization, covenant headroom, and drawdowns.
External Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the primary operational finance liaison for lenders, banks, auditors, and external advisers. Handle recurring reporting packages, fulfill information requests, and maintain smooth day-to-day working relationships (while senior negotiations remain with the CFO).
Planning & Cash Flow: Own the annual budget, rolling forecasts, and short-term cash tracking. Monitor working capital and minimum liquidity thresholds to spot funding needs well ahead of time.
Portfolio Analytics: Partner with Risk to analyze cohorts, vintages, DPD movements, roll rates, and loss trends—translating your findings into concrete pricing, credit, and funding recommendations.
Decision Materials: Create concise, executive-ready presentations for management, the board, and lenders that state the decision clearly, evaluate trade-offs, and suggest action steps.

You're a perfect match if you have

2+ years of of relevant analytical finance experience (FP&A, financial modeling, corporate finance, transaction advisory, or investment banking) with clear evidence of independent ownership.
Fintech / BNPL Domain experience: Direct exposure to credit platforms, BNPL, or lending operations.
Direct exposure to lending or receivables-based businesses (e.g., consumer finance, BNPL, or banking) with hands-on credit economics or funding facility exposure.
Advanced Excel & Modeling Mastery: Ability to build auditable, driver-based models from scratch with clear assumptions, logic, outputs, sensitivities, and built-in error checks.
Strong Cash & Commercial Judgment: Ability to turn incomplete or messy operational data into defensible financial strategies.
Fluency in English with exceptional written and verbal communication.
Location: Full-time onsite in our Riyadh office. Must be a Saudi National or a KSA resident eligible for an employer iqama transfer.Nice-to-Haves

Preferred:

Direct experience with asset-backed/warehouse funding facilities (borrowing bases, covenant tracking, lender reporting, drawdown schedules).
Hands-on experience with cohort, vintage, DPD, or roll-rate analysis.
Background in Big Four transaction advisory/consulting, especially if followed by in-house fintech or lending ownership.
Progress toward CFA, CPA, SOCPA, ACCA, or practical experience with SQL and BI tools.

Benefits

Competitive salary - Receive a competitive salary package in USD or SAR, reflecting your skills and contributions in our industry.
Diverse International team - Join a diverse international team where different perspectives and backgrounds enrich our collaborative culture.
Innovation - Shape the future of Proptech with your groundbreaking ideas and technological prowess.
Direct Impact - See your ideas come to life and make tangible changes in an industry ripe for revolution.

**Rize** is a groundbreaking rent\-now\-pay\-later platform reshaping the rental landscape in Saudi Arabia. We're dedicated to making rentals more accessible and affordable, enabling tenants to manage their finances with ease and landlords to secure their income effortlessly. We're on a mission to revolutionize the rental industry, breaking down barriers and creating opportunities for all. We're a team of innovators, thinkers, and problem\-solvers, committed to creating a positive impact and driving change in the market.

**Our Team**


We love working together, being creative, and doing things differently! Our team is made up of people with different nationalities. We work from a cozy office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. And hey, we're not just smart, we're really good at coming up with new ideas.

**Our core values \& Principles**

* **Innovation** – We’re a technology\-driven team with the purpose of uplifting the real estate sector. We are the leaders of the industry in innovation.
* **Customer Centricity** – We put the customer at the core of every decision and action.
* **Adaptability** \- Being able to adapt quickly to changing market conditions and customer needs.
* **Empowerment \& Collaboration** – Our team is the most valuable aspect of the company; We respect all ideas, our team enjoys authority, autonomy, and collaboration.
* **Ethical Excellence** \- We perform within the highest ethical standard.

**Job Summary**  

We are looking for a **Senior Financial Analyst** to partner closely with our CFO and turn complex financial and portfolio data into clear operating and funding decisions. In this role, you will own the models, forecasts, and analysis used by our executive team, funding partners, board, and investors. This role suits someone who builds from first principles, thrives through imperfect data, and communicates commercial and liquidity insights with razor\-sharp clarity.

**What will you be doing?**

* **Financial Modeling:** Build, stress\-test, and maintain driver\-based 3\-statement, funding, and scenario models. Connect contract economics, yield, funding cost, credit loss, and servicing cost\-to cash flow, profitability, and balance\-sheet outcomes.
* **Asset\-Backed Financing:** Own the analytical and reporting engine for asset\-backed and warehouse facilities, including eligibility, borrowing\-base availability, advance rates, utilization, covenant headroom, and drawdowns.
* **External Stakeholder Liaison:** Act as the primary operational finance liaison for lenders, banks, auditors, and external advisers. Handle recurring reporting packages, fulfill information requests, and maintain smooth day\-to\-day working relationships (while senior negotiations remain with the CFO).
* **Planning \& Cash Flow:** Own the annual budget, rolling forecasts, and short\-term cash tracking. Monitor working capital and minimum liquidity thresholds to spot funding needs well ahead of time.
* **Portfolio Analytics:** Partner with Risk to analyze cohorts, vintages, DPD movements, roll rates, and loss trends—translating your findings into concrete pricing, credit, and funding recommendations.
* **Decision Materials:** Create concise, executive\-ready presentations for management, the board, and lenders that state the decision clearly, evaluate trade\-offs, and suggest action steps.

 **You're a perfect match if you have**

* **2\+ years** of **of relevant analytical finance experience** (FP\&A, financial modeling, corporate finance, transaction advisory, or investment banking) with clear evidence of independent ownership.
* **Fintech / BNPL Domain experience:** Direct exposure to credit platforms, **BNPL**, or lending operations.
* **Direct exposure to lending or receivables\-based businesses** (e.g., consumer finance, BNPL, or banking) with hands\-on credit economics or funding facility exposure.
* **Advanced Excel \& Modeling Mastery:** Ability to build auditable, driver\-based models from scratch with clear assumptions, logic, outputs, sensitivities, and built\-in error checks.
* **Strong Cash \& Commercial Judgment:** Ability to turn incomplete or messy operational data into defensible financial strategies.
* **Fluency in English** with exceptional written and verbal communication.
* **Location:** Full\-time onsite in our Riyadh office. Must be a Saudi National or a KSA resident eligible for an employer iqama transfer.**Nice\-to\-Haves**

**Preferred:**

* Direct experience with **asset\-backed/warehouse funding facilities** (borrowing bases, covenant tracking, lender reporting, drawdown schedules).
* Hands\-on experience with **cohort, vintage, DPD, or roll\-rate analysis**.
* Background in Big Four transaction advisory/consulting, especially if followed by in\-house fintech or lending ownership.
* Progress toward CFA, CPA, SOCPA, ACCA, or practical experience with SQL and BI tools.

### **Benefits**

**What do we offer?**

* **Competitive salary** \- Receive a competitive salary package in USD or SAR, reflecting your skills and contributions in our industry.
* **Diverse International team** \- Join a diverse international team where different perspectives and backgrounds enrich our collaborative culture.
* **Innovation** \- Shape the future of Proptech with your groundbreaking ideas and technological prowess.
* **Direct Impact** \- See your ideas come to life and make tangible changes in an industry ripe for revolution.
* **Fast\-paced Learning** \- Grow personally and professionally every day with opportunities to master new skills in our dynamic start\-up environment.
* **Creative Freedom** \- Take the reins, innovate, and push boundaries with the freedom to experiment, learn, and grow at Rize.
* **Close\-knit Community** \- Join a collaborative, supportive team where your voice matters and your contributions are recognized and celebrated.
